findings.finding: Target-specific certification could not build on program-wide predecessor rounds and rejected schema-v2 heads.

findings.finding: Always-on manifest validation accepted contradictory converged rounds.
findings.repair: Applied closed finding dispositions, reasons, fingerprints, unresolved-list, and result/flag consistency to every converged manifest round.

findings.finding: Refuted analytic claims bypassed transitive computation-bridge enforcement.
findings.repair: Applied structured computation bridges to established, proved, and refuted analytic claims.
